title: Zero-Cost Trait Abstraction
goal: Select the zero-cost generic signature over redundant allocations.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Generics vs dyn

hints: The item parameter already implements Summarize by reference.
Passing a generic trait reference accepts any implementing type without concrete struct coupling.
explanation: Passing `&impl Summarize` accepts any type implementing `Summarize`. It operates directly by reference without requiring a concrete struct type. Candidates expecting `&Article` fail to compile when called with other summarizing types like `NewsFlash`.
